source: Woku active MCP registrations, all toolsets

tools.name: woku_guide
tools.title: woku guide
tools.description: Start here. Returns woku playbooks: for each intent, the ordered tool calls with their key args, the id-discovery chains (list_*/search -> get_*/fetch), the rating scales, and the write-safety rules. Call it with no args for the topic index and the id rules; pass topic for a step-by-step recipe; pass question in natural language to get the best-matching topic. Read this before calling other woku tools. Read-only; content is English in v1.

topic.description: Playbook key for detail mode. Omit for the index.

question.description: Natural-language intent; picks the best-matching topic.

locale.description: Reserved; content is English in v1. Defaults to en.

tools.name: design_voc_program
tools.title: Design a VoC program
tools.description: Proposes a Voice-of-Customer program blueprint for the connected company from the woku method: a customer journey where every moment of truth is heard with a fast (<60s) instrument, and every signal becomes an action (one signal -> a support ticket; recurring signals -> an action plan), with trackers as the connective tissue that routes tickets and groups plans. Returns the journey with a recommended instrument (NPS/CSAT/CES/Woku) and channel per moment, the tracker design, the action wiring, and ordered next steps that name the real create_* tools. Deterministic and read-only: it creates nothing. Optionally pass businessType, channels, your own moments and segmentBy to adapt the template.

businessType.description: Business type, e.g. "ecommerce", "retail", "saas", "services". Lightly adapts the channel emphasis and notes.

channels.description: Delivery channels you can use. The suggested channel per moment is chosen from these (defaults to all four; WhatsApp/email are preferred).

description.description: What the customer is doing at this moment.

moments.description: Your own journey moments. Each is mapped to the most fitting instrument; the canonical five moments are still returned as a reference. Omit to use the canonical journey.

segmentBy.description: How to design the trackers. Defaults to all three (journey, moment, locality).

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get connected company
tools.description: Profile of the company this connection is bound to: name, default locale, timezone, website, social/branding links, logo URL, non-sensitive feature flags (SSO, sandbox, integrity hash, improvement emails, follow-up agent), environment and timestamps.

tools.name: list_company_members
tools.title: List company members
tools.description: Members of the connected company with their role and membership status. Emails and credentials are never exposed.

tools.name: get_company_statistics
tools.title: Get company statistics
tools.description: Feedback activity statistics for the connected company. Without arguments: totals and counts for the last day/week/month/year across reviews, NPS, CSAT, CES and form responses. With metric+year: daily breakdown for that year in the company timezone (wokus: improvements/recognitions per day; nps: promoters/passives/detractors per day; form: responses per day). CSAT/CES have no per-day breakdown yet, so they appear only in the summary.

metric.description: Which statistics to fetch. Defaults to summary.

year.description: Required for wokus/nps/form: calendar year, e.g. 2026

tools.name: list_nps_tools
tools.title: List NPS tools
tools.description: Lists the NPS survey tools of the connected company. Returns per tool: id, name, survey message, audience, creation date and response count; plus company totals (tools, NPS responses, general-survey responses without a tool) and cursor pagination (pass nextCursor to fetch the next page).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the id of the last tool received

tools.name: get_nps_statistics
tools.title: Get NPS statistics
tools.description: NPS statistics: score (round of %promoters - %detractors; promoters 9-10, passives 7-8, detractors 0-6), total responses, distribution with counts and percentages, a histogram (11-element array, index = score 0-10, value = response count) and opinion counts from text/voice comments (recognitions/improvements). Without arguments: all NPS responses of the connected company. With npsToolId: only that NPS survey tool. Optional from/to (ISO 8601, both inclusive) restrict the responses by createdAt.

npsToolId.description: Id of an NPS tool (from list_nps_tools) to scope the statistics to. Omit for company-wide statistics.

from.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) on the response createdAt. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (inclusive) on the response createdAt. Omit for no upper bound.

tools.name: list_nps_responses
tools.title: List NPS responses
tools.description: Individual NPS responses of the connected company, newest first. Each response has: id, score (0-10), classification (promoter 9-10 / passive 7-8 / detractor 0-6), comment (from the text or voice note), responseChannel, npsToolId, anonymous flag, client display name when not anonymous, and createdAt (ISO 8601). Also returns the filtered total and cursor pagination. Without arguments: every response (combined). With npsToolId: only that tool (verifies ownership). scope=general returns only general-survey responses (no tool). Optional classification, from and to (ISO 8601, both inclusive) filters.

npsToolId.description: Id of an NPS tool (from list_nps_tools) to scope the responses to. Omit for company-wide responses.

scope.description: Company-wide scope: 'combined' (default) returns all responses; 'general' returns only general-survey responses without a tool. Ignored when npsToolId is set.

classification.description: Filter responses by NPS classification (promoter 9-10, passive 7-8, detractor 0-6).

from.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) on the response createdAt. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (inclusive) on the response createdAt. Omit for no upper bound.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the id of the last response received

tools.name: send_nps_invitations
tools.title: Send NPS invitations
tools.description: Sends an NPS survey invitation to a batch of customers over email or WhatsApp. This reaches REAL customers: you must pass confirm: true. For channel "email" the recipients are email addresses; for "whatsapp" they are phone numbers in E.164 format. Up to 100 recipients per call. Optionally scope to one NPS tool (npsToolId, from list_nps_tools) and pick the message language (es/en). Returns the channel, the requested count, how many were sent and the per-recipient failures.

npsToolId.description: Id of an NPS tool (from list_nps_tools) whose survey to send. Omit to use the company general NPS survey.

channel.description: Delivery channel. "email" sends to email addresses; "whatsapp" sends to E.164 phone numbers.

recipients.description: Recipients (1-100). Email addresses for the email channel, E.164 phone numbers for the whatsapp channel.

language.description: Message language. Defaults to the company locale.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send; reaches real customers.

tools.name: create_nps_tool
tools.title: Create NPS tool
tools.description: Create an NPS survey tool for the connected company. Required: name (1-140 chars) and npsMessage (ONLY the recommended company/product/service, e.g. "our company", NOT the full question; 3-140 chars, must contain a letter). Optional: audienceType (only who the survey targets, e.g. "a friend or colleague"), availableLocales (subset of es/en), defaultLocale (es/en) and localizedContent (per-locale fragments). The public question is composed automatically as "On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend {npsMessage} to {audienceType}?"; the result includes a questionPreview so you can verify it. Missing-locale translations are filled automatically. Returns the created tool.

npsMessage.description: Only the company, product or service recommended (e.g. "our company"), NOT the full question. The public question is composed as "On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend {npsMessage} to {audienceType}?" (3-140 chars, must contain a letter).

audienceType.description: Only who the survey targets, e.g. "a friend or colleague" or "customers" (must contain a letter); NOT the full question.

availableLocales.description: Locales the tool is available in (subset of es/en).

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when none is requested (es/en).

npsMessage.description: Recommended company/product/service fragment for this locale, NOT the full question.

audienceType.description: Audience fragment for this locale, NOT the full question.

localizedContent.description: Per-locale translations of the NPS copy.

tools.name: update_nps_tool
tools.title: Update NPS tool
tools.description: Update an NPS survey tool of the connected company. Provide npsToolId and at least one field to change: name (1-140), npsMessage (ONLY the recommended company/product/service fragment, 3-140, must contain a letter, NOT the full question), audienceType (only who the survey targets), availableLocales (subset of es/en), defaultLocale (es/en) or localizedContent (per-locale fragments). The result includes a questionPreview of the composed public question. Only NPS tools without any response can be edited; editing one that already has responses fails. Returns the updated tool.

npsMessage.description: New recommended company/product/service fragment (3-140 chars, must contain a letter), NOT the full question.

audienceType.description: New audience fragment, e.g. "partners" (must contain a letter), NOT the full question.

availableLocales.description: Locales the tool is available in (subset of es/en).

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when none is requested (es/en).

npsMessage.description: Recommended company/product/service fragment for this locale, NOT the full question.

audienceType.description: Audience fragment for this locale, NOT the full question.

localizedContent.description: Per-locale translations of the NPS copy.

tools.name: delete_nps_tool
tools.title: Delete NPS tool
tools.description: Permanently delete an NPS survey tool of the connected company together with all of its responses. This cannot be undone. Requires confirm=true; without it the tool refuses to act. Returns the deleted tool id/name and how many responses were removed.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: get_csat_metrics
tools.title: Get CSAT metrics
tools.description: CSAT (customer satisfaction with a subject, 1-5 scale) metrics for the connected company. Without arguments returns the company-wide summary (response count, average score, top-2-box, 1-5 distribution, comment stats) plus a per-tool breakdown including each tool last response date. With csatToolId returns the metrics of that single CSAT tool, including its cached AI comment summary.

csatToolId.description: Scope metrics to one CSAT tool (id from the per-tool breakdown)

tools.name: get_ces_metrics
tools.title: Get CES metrics
tools.description: CES (customer effort of an action, 1-5 scale) metrics for the connected company. Without arguments returns the company-wide summary (response count, average score, top-2-box, 1-5 distribution, comment stats) plus a per-tool breakdown including each tool last response date. With cesToolId returns the metrics of that single CES tool, including its cached AI comment summary.

cesToolId.description: Scope metrics to one CES tool (id from the per-tool breakdown)

tools.name: list_csat_responses
tools.title: List CSAT responses
tools.description: Paginated individual CSAT responses (customer satisfaction with a subject; a mandatory 1-5 score and an optional comment) of the connected company, newest first. Optional filters: toolId (one CSAT tool), withComment (keep only responses that carry a text or voice comment), and a createdAt range with from/to (ISO 8601). Each response returns id, toolId, score (1-5), comment text, commentType (textnote/voicemail), feedbackType (recognition/improvement) when classified, responseChannel and createdAt (ISO 8601), plus the total matching count. Filtering by score value or by feedbackType is not yet supported by the underlying query.

toolId.description: Scope to one CSAT tool (24-hex Mongo ObjectId)

withComment.description: Keep only responses that carry a text or voice comment

tools.name: list_ces_responses
tools.title: List CES responses
tools.description: Paginated individual CES responses (customer effort of an action; a mandatory 1-5 score and an optional comment) of the connected company, newest first. Optional filters: toolId (one CES tool), withComment (keep only responses that carry a text or voice comment), and a createdAt range with from/to (ISO 8601). Each response returns id, toolId, score (1-5), comment text, commentType (textnote/voicemail), feedbackType (recognition/improvement) when classified, responseChannel and createdAt (ISO 8601), plus the total matching count. Filtering by score value or by feedbackType is not yet supported by the underlying query.

toolId.description: Scope to one CES tool (24-hex Mongo ObjectId)

withComment.description: Keep only responses that carry a text or voice comment

tools.name: send_csat_survey
tools.title: Send CSAT survey
tools.description: Send a CSAT survey (customer satisfaction, 1-5 scale) of the connected company to real customers over email or WhatsApp. Requires confirm: true because this reaches real customers. channel.description: Delivery channel for the survey invitation

recipients.description: Email addresses (email channel) or E.164 phone numbers (whatsapp channel). Non-empty, at most 100.

cesToolId.description: The CES tool id (24-hex Mongo ObjectId) to send

language.description: Survey language. Defaults to the tool/company default.

cesToolId.description: The CES tool id (24-hex Mongo ObjectId) to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion (also removes all responses).

tools.name: list_wokus
tools.title: List wokus
tools.description: Paginated list of the wokus (feedback collection tools) of the connected company. Returns per woku: id, title, folder id, review count and disabled/closed flags, plus the total count. Optionally filter by folder: pass folderId="root" for wokus not inside any folder, or a folder ObjectId for the wokus directly in that folder.

search.description: Case-insensitive text filter on the woku title.

folderId.description: Folder filter: "root" for wokus outside any folder, or a folder ObjectId for the wokus directly in that folder. Omit for all wokus.

tools.name: get_woku
tools.title: Get woku detail
tools.description: Detail of one woku of the connected company: title, locales, folder, settings flags (anonymousDisabled, reviewsDisabled, closed, onlyOneReviewPerClient), review counts, average score and the AI feedback summary when available.

tools.name: list_woku_reviews
tools.title: List woku reviews
tools.description: Paginated reviews of one woku of the connected company, newest first. Each review has: id, type (textnote/voicemail), score (1-5), comment text, feedbackType (recognition/improvement), client display name when not anonymous, response channel and createdAt. Also returns the total count.

tools.name: update_woku
tools.title: Update woku
tools.description: Rename a woku or change its locale settings. Optional inputs: title (new description, 3-140 chars), defaultLocale (es/en) and localizedContent (per-locale translations). Only wokus without any review can be edited; editing one that already has reviews fails. Returns the updated woku. Note: the woku image cannot be changed here (it requires a binary upload).

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when none is requested.

tools.name: move_woku
tools.title: Move woku to folder
tools.description: Move a woku into a folder, or remove it from its current folder. Pass folderId as a folder ObjectId to place the woku in that folder, or null to move it back to the root (no folder). Returns the woku with its new folder.

folderId.description: Destination folder ObjectId, or null to remove the woku from its folder (move to root).

tools.name: update_woku_settings
tools.title: Update woku settings
tools.description: Set one or more of a woku boolean settings to an explicit value: anonymousDisabled (block anonymous reviews), reviewsDisabled (stop accepting reviews), closed (close the woku) and onlyOneReviewPerClient (one review per client). Only the flags you pass change; the rest are left untouched. Returns the resulting settings and the list of flags that changed.

anonymousDisabled.description: true to block anonymous reviews, false to allow them.

reviewsDisabled.description: true to stop accepting new reviews, false to accept.

closed.description: true to close the woku, false to reopen it.

onlyOneReviewPerClient.description: true to allow only one review per client, false to lift.

tools.name: delete_woku
tools.title: Delete woku
tools.description: Permanently delete a woku of the connected company and its reviews. This cannot be undone. Requires confirm=true; without it the tool refuses to act.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: send_woku_invitations
tools.title: Send woku invitations
tools.description: Send review invitations for one woku of the connected company to a batch of customers over email or WhatsApp. Each recipient gets one invitation; the call reaches real customers. For channel="email" pass email addresses; for channel="whatsapp" pass phone numbers in E.164 format. Up to 100 recipients per call. Requires confirm=true. Returns the requested count plus per-recipient successes and failures.

recipients.description: Recipients: email addresses when channel="email", E.164 phone numbers when channel="whatsapp". 1-100 entries.

language.description: Invitation language (es/en). Defaults to the woku.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send; reaches real customers.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: Paginated folders of the connected company. Without parentFolderId returns the root folders; with it returns that folder's direct children. Each folder has: id, name, color, full path breadcrumb, parentFolderId, wokuCount (subtree total), subfolderCount, an ambiguous flag (true when a sibling shares its name) and createdAt, plus the total count.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder id (24-hex Mongo ObjectId) to list its direct children. Omit for the root folders.

tools.name: get_folder
tools.title: Get folder detail
tools.description: Detail of one folder of the connected company: its name, color, path, parent, subtree wokuCount, directWokuCount, subfolderCount and ambiguous flag, plus its direct child folders and the wokus (id + title) that live directly in it.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create a folder for the connected company, optionally nested under an existing folder. Returns the created folder.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder id (24-hex Mongo ObjectId) to nest under. Omit for a root folder.

tools.name: move_folder
tools.title: Move folder into another folder
tools.description: Reparent a folder of the connected company under another folder. Both the folder and the destination parent folder must belong to the company, and a folder cannot be moved into itself. Returns the moved folder with its new parent. (Moving a folder back to the root is not available yet.)

folderId.description: Folder id to move (24-hex Mongo ObjectId).

parentFolderId.description: Destination parent folder id (24-hex Mongo ObjectId) to nest the folder under.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.title: List flows
tools.description: Lists the flows of the connected company (automated sequences of wokus for collecting feedback), newest first. Returns per flow: id, name, wokusIds, linked NPS (npsToolId or companyIdNps), creation and update dates; plus the total count and page/limit.

tools.name: get_flow
tools.title: Get flow
tools.description: Returns a single flow of the connected company by id: name, wokusIds, linked NPS (npsToolId or companyIdNps) and timestamps.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.title: Create flow
tools.description: Creates a flow in the connected company: a named sequence of wokus. Provide a name and at least one woku id (all wokus must belong to this company and must not be closed or one-review-per-client). Optionally pass npsId to link an NPS: use the company id for the company-level NPS, or a specific NPS tool id. Returns the created flow.

wokusIds.description: Woku ids to include in the sequence (at least one, 24-hex Mongo ObjectIds).

npsId.description: Optional NPS link: the company id for the company-level NPS, or a specific NPS tool id.

tools.name: update_flow
tools.title: Update flow
tools.description: Updates a flow of the connected company. Provide the flowId plus at least one of: name, wokusIds (the new full sequence, at least one woku of this company). The linked NPS cannot be changed here. Returns the updated flow.

wokusIds.description: New full sequence of woku ids (at least one, 24-hex Mongo ObjectIds of this company).

tools.name: delete_flow
tools.title: Delete flow
tools.description: Permanently delete a flow of the connected company. This cannot be undone. Requires confirm=true; without it the tool refuses to act.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.title: List company forms
tools.description: Lists the forms of the connected company, newest first. Returns per form: id, name, description, status, whether it is closed, number of fields and total response count, plus the overall total of forms.

tools.name: get_form_summary
tools.title: Get form AI summary
tools.description: Returns the cached AI-generated summary of a form as markdown text, with the form name, how many responses it analyzed and when it was generated. Summaries exist only for forms with enough responses where a previous generation ran; otherwise reports that none is available.

formId.description: Id of the form to summarize

tools.name: list_form_responses
tools.title: List form responses
tools.description: Paginated responses of a form, newest first. Returns per response: id, submitted answers keyed by the question label, anonymous flag, response channel, status, date and the identified client (email/phone) when not anonymous; plus totalCount, hasMore and nextCursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: pass the nextCursor of the previous page to fetch the next one

tools.name: send_form_invitations
tools.title: Send form invitations
tools.description: Sends invitations to answer a form to a list of recipients, over email or WhatsApp. Reaches real customers, so it requires confirm: true. For email, recipients are email addresses and the whole batch is dispatched at once; for WhatsApp, recipients are E.164 phone numbers dispatched one by one. Returns the channel, requested count and how many succeeded/failed.

formId.description: Id of the form to send invitations for

recipients.description: Recipients: email addresses for the email channel, E.164 phone numbers for the whatsapp channel

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send; reaches real customers.

tools.name: create_form
tools.title: Create form
tools.description: Create a form (dynamic questionnaire) for the connected company. Provide a name, the list of fields and the settings. Each field has a type (text, number, date, email, phone, select or multiselect), a label, whether it is required and a display order; select/multiselect fields must include a non-empty options list. Field ids are generated automatically unless you pass one. The form is created open and active. Returns the created form.

id.description: Stable field id (UUID). Omit on new fields to auto-generate one; pass the existing id to preserve structure when editing a form that already has responses.

label.description: Field label shown to the respondent (1-200 characters).

type.description: Field type: text, number, date, email or phone (free input), or select/multiselect (choice, needs options).

options.description: Choices for select/multiselect fields (1-100, each non-blank, max 200 chars). Required for those types, ignored otherwise.

fields.description: Form fields (0-100). Each field carries its own display order.

allowAnonymous.description: Whether the form accepts anonymous responses.

oneResponsePerClient.description: Whether a client can respond only once (default false).

availableLocales.description: Locales the form is available in (default ["es"]).

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when none is requested (default "es").

id.description: Base field id this translation applies to.

fields.description: Per-field translated copies, keyed by base field id.

tools.name: update_form
tools.title: Update form
tools.description: Update an existing form of the connected company. Every input is optional; only the fields you pass change. You can rename it, edit its description, replace its fields, change its settings, open/close it or switch its active/inactive status. Once a form has responses its structure is locked: replacing fields is then limited to copy edits (label, options, order, required, placeholder) with the same field ids and types, and adding, removing or retyping a field is rejected. Returns the updated form.

formId.description: Id of the form to update (24-hex Mongo ObjectId).

id.description: Stable field id (UUID). Omit on new fields to auto-generate one; pass the existing id to preserve structure when editing a form that already has responses.

label.description: Field label shown to the respondent (1-200 characters).

type.description: Field type: text, number, date, email or phone (free input), or select/multiselect (choice, needs options).

options.description: Choices for select/multiselect fields (1-100, each non-blank, max 200 chars). Required for those types, ignored otherwise.

fields.description: Replacement field list (0-100). Pass existing field ids to preserve structure on forms that already have responses.

allowAnonymous.description: Whether the form accepts anonymous responses.

oneResponsePerClient.description: Whether a client can respond only once (default false).

closed.description: true to close the form (stop accepting responses), false to reopen.

availableLocales.description: Locales the form is available in.

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when none is requested.

id.description: Base field id this translation applies to.

fields.description: Per-field translated copies, keyed by base field id.

localizedContent.description: Authored per-locale translations. Missing locales are filled automatically after save.

tools.name: get_form
tools.title: Get form
tools.description: Returns the full definition of one form of the connected company: name, description, status, whether it is closed, its fields (id, label, type, required, placeholder, options, order), its settings and any locale translations. Use it to inspect a form before editing it.

formId.description: Id of the form (24-hex Mongo ObjectId).

tools.name: delete_form
tools.title: Delete form
tools.description: Permanently delete a form of the connected company together with all its responses and its cached AI summary. This cannot be undone. Requires confirm=true; without it the tool refuses to act. Returns the deleted form id, its name and how many responses were removed.

formId.description: Id of the form to delete (24-hex Mongo ObjectId).

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.title: List company clients
tools.description: Paginated list of the connected company clients. Returns for each client: id, email, phone, whatsappId, custom fields (client names live there) and creation date, plus totalCount/hasMore/nextCursor. Optional search matches email, phone and custom field values, accent-insensitive.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the id of the last client from the previous page (use nextCursor)

search.description: Case- and accent-insensitive text to match against email, phone and custom field values

tools.name: get_client_stats
tools.title: Get client statistics
tools.description: Feedback statistics for one client of the connected company: contact info, woku review count with average star qualification and recognition/improvement split, NPS response count with average score and promoter/passive/detractor breakdown, and form response count.

clientId.description: Id of the client to inspect

tools.name: list_client_feedback
tools.title: List client feedback
tools.description: Paginated feedback items left by one client of the connected company, from a single source, newest first. source "woku" returns star reviews (score 1-5), "nps" returns NPS responses (score 0-10) and "form" returns form responses (no numeric score). Each item carries: id, source, type (textnote/voicemail when applicable), score with its scale, comment, feedbackType, the tool/woku id and name when known, response channel and createdAt (ISO 8601). Also returns totalCount/hasMore/nextCursor.

clientId.description: Id of the client to inspect

source.description: Feedback source to read: "woku" (star reviews), "nps" or "form"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the id of the last feedback item from the previous page (use nextCursor)

tools.name: get_client_form_config
tools.title: Get client form configuration
tools.description: Return the connected company client form configuration: the custom fields that a client customFields object accepts, each with id (the key to use inside customFields), label, type (text/number/date/select/multiselect/email/phone), required flag, placeholder, options (for select/multiselect) and order. Call this before create_client, update_client or import_clients to learn which customFields keys are valid and which are required. Returns an empty fields list when the company has no form configuration yet.

tools.name: create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a client for the connected company. email is required (this path stores an email-bearing client; a phone alone is not a valid contact). customFields is required and is keyed by the company FormConfig field ids (pass {} only if the form has no required fields); use get_client_form_config to discover the valid keys and which are required. The company must have a form configuration. Contact values are passed raw; the server encrypts them. Returns the created client.

phone.description: Optional phone number (digits, spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses and an optional leading +).

customFields.description: Custom fields keyed by FormConfig field ids (see get_client_form_config). Pass {} if the form has no required fields.

tools.name: update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: Update one client of the connected company. Provide at least one of: email, phone or customFields. customFields is merged into the existing fields (keys not passed are kept) and validated against the company FormConfig (unknown keys and invalid values are rejected); use get_client_form_config to discover the valid keys. Contact values are passed raw; the server encrypts them. Returns the updated client.

clientId.description: Id of the client to update.

phone.description: New phone number (digits, spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses and an optional leading +).

customFields.description: Custom fields to merge, keyed by FormConfig field ids (see get_client_form_config).

tools.name: import_clients
tools.title: Import clients
tools.description: Bulk-create clients for the connected company from an array of rows (1-500). Each row needs at least one contact method: email or whatsappId (a phone alone is not enough). Optional per row: phone and customFields (keyed by the company FormConfig field ids; see get_client_form_config). Invalid or duplicate rows are skipped and reported per row; valid rows are created. Contact values are passed raw; the server encrypts them. Returns { created, duplicates, errors: [{ row, reason }] }.

whatsappId.description: WhatsApp id / phone with country code (dedup key when no email).

customFields.description: Custom fields keyed by FormConfig field ids (see get_client_form_config).

clients.description: Rows to import (1-500); each row needs at least an email or a whatsappId.

tools.name: delete_client
tools.title: Delete client
tools.description: Permanently delete one client of the connected company. This cannot be undone. Only clients with no associated feedback (no woku reviews, NPS, form responses or follow-ups) can be deleted; deleting one that has feedback fails. Requires confirm=true; without it the tool refuses to act. Returns the deleted client.

clientId.description: Id of the client to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.title: List support tickets
tools.description: Paginated list of AI-generated support tickets for the connected company, newest first. Returns per-ticket triage fields (code, title, severity, origin tool, AI category, score, client, dates) plus total/page/limit. Filterable by tool, severity, destination, free text, trackers and date range. With includeStats=true it also returns ticket counts by origin tool and by SAC destination for the same filters.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

tool.description: Only tickets originated from this feedback tool

search.description: Free-text search over title, code, client and comment

destinationId.description: Only tickets routed to this SAC destination id

trackers.description: Tracker filters as "name:value" strings; every filter must match (AND), value is a partial case-insensitive match. A bare "name" (no value) matches any value of that tracker.

from.description: Only tickets created at/after this ISO date

to.description: Only tickets created at/before this ISO date

includeStats.description: Also return ticket counts grouped by origin tool and by SAC destination. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.title: Get support ticket
tools.description: Full detail of one support ticket of the connected company: the AI-built case (summary, category, description, what the customer wants, suggested resolution), origin feedback, score, client identity, history snapshot and delivery timeline.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.title: Update support ticket
tools.description: Update the triage metadata of one support ticket: title, severity (high|medium|low), AI summary and/or AI category. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated triage fields.

aiSummary.description: New short summary of the problem

tools.name: list_ticket_destinations
tools.title: List ticket destinations
tools.description: List the SAC delivery destinations (Zendesk, custom HTTP or email) configured for the connected company. Returns each destination secret-safe: kind, non-secret config, AI context, routing conditions, a masked credentials hint, enabled flag, status and last delivery info. Filter by kind or hide disabled destinations. Recipient emails of email destinations are never returned (a count is).

includeDisabled.description: Include disabled destinations. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_ticket_destination
tools.title: Get ticket destination
tools.description: Full secret-safe detail of one SAC ticket destination of the connected company: kind, non-secret config, AI context, routing conditions, masked credentials hint, enabled flag, status and last delivery info. Never returns stored credentials.

tools.name: create_ticket_destination
tools.title: Create ticket destination
tools.description: Create a SAC destination where AI support tickets are delivered. Requires the mcp:write scope. Per-kind config: zendesk { connectionId(24-hex), groupId? }; custom { url(http/https), method?(POST|PUT), headers?(no Authorization) }; email { emails[] 1..20 }. zendesk authenticates via the company OAuth integration (no secret is stored) and ignores any credentials; email carries none. A custom destination may set inline auth via credentials (authType none|basic|bearer|api-key-header); WARNING: an inline secret passed this way transits through the agent (it is encrypted at rest and never echoed back). A template is only allowed for kind=custom. IMPORTANT: this path does NOT verify the backing integration is connected, so a connection-backed destination pointing at a missing or disabled integration will silently dead-letter deliveries; confirm the integration is connected in the woku admin. Output is always secret-safe.

authType.description: Auth for a custom webhook: 'none' (default), 'basic', 'bearer' or 'api-key-header'. Only meaningful for kind=custom.

token.description: Bearer token, min 4 chars (required when authType is 'bearer').

headerName.description: API-key header name, [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64} (required when authType is 'api-key-header').

headerValue.description: API-key header value (required when authType is 'api-key-header').

credentials.description: Optional inline auth for a custom webhook (authType none|basic|bearer|api-key-header). Ignored for zendesk/email. WARNING: a secret here passes through the agent.

relationToPrevious.description: How this row joins the previous one: "AND" same group, "OR" starts a new group. The first row omits it.

trackerId.description: CompanyExternalTracker id this row matches on

operator.description: "equals" matches a specific value; "any" matches any value of the tracker (value is then ignored). Defaults to "equals".

value.description: The value the tracker must equal (required unless operator is "any")

routingConditions.description: Tracker routing rows (AND binds tighter than OR); the destination receives a ticket when any OR-group fully matches.

template.description: Custom payload template. Allowed only when kind=custom.

tools.name: update_ticket_destination
tools.title: Update ticket destination
tools.description: Edit a SAC ticket destination of the connected company. Requires the mcp:write scope. Every field is optional; provide at least one. Enable or disable with { enabled }. config/routingConditions REPLACE the stored value (resend the full list to edit one row); config is re-validated against the effective kind. A template is only allowed when the effective kind is custom. Pass credentials to rotate a custom destination's inline auth (authType none clears it); WARNING: an inline secret transits through the agent (encrypted at rest, never echoed). Omit credentials to leave the stored auth untouched. IMPORTANT: this path does NOT verify the backing integration is connected, so a connection-backed destination pointing at a missing or disabled integration will silently dead-letter deliveries; confirm the integration in the woku admin. Output is always secret-safe.

config.description: Full replacement of the per-kind config

authType.description: Auth for a custom webhook: 'none' (default), 'basic', 'bearer' or 'api-key-header'. Only meaningful for kind=custom.

token.description: Bearer token, min 4 chars (required when authType is 'bearer').

headerName.description: API-key header name, [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64} (required when authType is 'api-key-header').

headerValue.description: API-key header value (required when authType is 'api-key-header').

credentials.description: Optional; rotate a custom webhook's inline auth (authType none|basic|bearer|api-key-header). Omit to leave the stored auth untouched. WARNING: a secret here passes through the agent.

relationToPrevious.description: How this row joins the previous one: "AND" same group, "OR" starts a new group. The first row omits it.

trackerId.description: CompanyExternalTracker id this row matches on

operator.description: "equals" matches a specific value; "any" matches any value of the tracker (value is then ignored). Defaults to "equals".

value.description: The value the tracker must equal (required unless operator is "any")

routingConditions.description: Full replacement of the routing rows

template.description: Custom payload template. Allowed only when the effective kind is custom.

tools.name: delete_ticket_destination
tools.title: Delete ticket destination
tools.description: Permanently delete a SAC ticket destination of the connected company, including its routing conditions. This cannot be undone. Requires the mcp:write scope and confirm=true. Returns the deleted destination id.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: test_ticket_destination
tools.title: Test ticket destination
tools.description: Run a connectivity test against an ALREADY-SAVED SAC ticket destination of the connected company, by id. The destination config and credentials are resolved server-side from the stored record (and the company OAuth integration for zendesk); this tool never accepts a URL or inline credentials. It makes ONE real outbound request to the provider (email destinations are validated without any outbound call), so it requires the mcp:write scope and confirm=true. Returns only a sanitized { ok, status?, message } (never any credential, recipient or raw provider body).

confirm.description: Must be true: this makes a real outbound request to the saved provider.

tools.name: list_action_plans
tools.title: List action plans
tools.description: Paginated list of AI-generated improvement action plans of the connected company, newest first. Returns per-plan rows (id, title, summary, status, priority, VoC sources, evidence counters, delivery provider, createdAt) plus total/page/limit. Filterable by status, priority, source, group, free text and creation date range.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

source.description: Only plans whose evidence includes this VoC source

groupId.description: Only plans of this action-plan group id

search.description: Free-text search over title and summary

from.description: Only plans created at/after this ISO date (inclusive)

to.description: Only plans created before this ISO date (exclusive)

tools.name: get_action_plan
tools.title: Get action plan
tools.description: Full detail of one action plan of the connected company: title, summary, objective, expected impact, tasks, detected patterns, frozen evidence snapshot (window, counters, customer quotes), status/approval fields and delivery state, plus its most recent history events. The AI chat conversation is not included (not exposed over MCP).

tools.name: update_action_plan_task
tools.title: Update action plan task
tools.description: Edit one task of a DRAFT or managed (in_progress) action plan (409 otherwise). `text` edits a draft or managed plan; `status` and `assigneeId` only apply to a managed plan (kanban board). Provide at least one field. Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass). Returns the plan id, status and updated task list.

status.description: Kanban status of a managed task

assigneeId.description: Group member responsible; empty string clears it

tools.name: approve_action_plan
tools.title: Approve action plan
tools.description: Approve a DRAFT action plan (draft -> approved; any other status is a 409 error). Requires an admin role in the plan group (company admins always pass). Approving does NOT send the plan to any integration. Returns the plan id, new status and approval date.

tools.name: change_action_plan_status
tools.title: Change action plan status
tools.description: Move an action plan through its lifecycle: reopen (approved/delivery_error -> draft), cancel (draft/approved/delivery_error/in_progress -> canceled, terminal), complete (in_progress -> completed) or resume (completed -> in_progress). Any other transition is a 409. To approve a draft use approve_action_plan. Requires an admin role in the plan group (company admins always pass). Canceling is irreversible and needs confirm=true. Returns the plan id and new status.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when action is "cancel" (terminal).

tools.name: create_action_plan_task
tools.title: Add action plan task
tools.description: Append a task to a DRAFT or managed (in_progress) action plan (409 otherwise; max 100 tasks). The task is added at the end with status "todo". Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass). Returns the plan id, status and full task list.

tools.name: delete_action_plan_task
tools.title: Delete action plan task
tools.description: Remove one task from a DRAFT or managed (in_progress) action plan (409 otherwise). Remaining tasks are re-densified in order. Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass) and confirm=true. Returns the plan id, status and remaining task list.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the task removal.

tools.name: reorder_action_plan_tasks
tools.title: Reorder action plan tasks
tools.description: Reorder the tasks of a DRAFT or managed (in_progress) action plan (409 otherwise). `orderedTaskIds` must be EXACTLY the current task ids in the desired order (same set, no omissions or duplicates), so fetch the plan with get_action_plan first. Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass). Returns the plan id, status and reordered task list.

orderedTaskIds.description: All current task ids in the desired order

tools.name: get_action_plan_events
tools.title: Get action plan events
tools.description: The history timeline of one action plan of the connected company (AI generation, task edits, status changes, delivery events, etc.), oldest first. Use this for the full audit trail; get_action_plan only embeds the most recent events. Returns the most recent `limit` events plus the total count.

limit.description: Max events to return (1-100, most recent). Defaults to 50.

tools.name: get_action_plan_conversation
tools.title: Get action plan conversation
tools.description: Read the AI chat of one action plan of the connected company (AP-0004 left panel): messages oldest first (the seeded initial agent message included), the participants and the `busy` flag. `busy` is the poll signal ;  while it is true the AI agent is composing a turn and new messages are rejected; poll this tool until busy is false to read the reply queued by reply_to_action_plan. Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass).

tools.name: reply_to_action_plan
tools.title: Reply to action plan chat
tools.description: Post a human message to the AI chat of a DRAFT action plan (409 if the plan is not a draft or the agent is already busy). WARNING: each call triggers a PAID AI turn ;  the agent always answers, and its reply is delivered ASYNCHRONOUSLY (it is NOT in this response). After posting, poll get_action_plan_conversation until `busy` is false to read the agent reply. Requires membership in the plan group (company admins always pass) and confirm=true. Returns an acknowledgement with the persisted human message.

confirm.description: Must be true: each call triggers a paid AI turn whose reply is delivered asynchronously.

tools.name: list_action_plan_groups
tools.title: List action plan groups
tools.description: List the action-plan groups of the connected company, oldest first. A group routes feedback (by tracker conditions) to a team and drafts an improvement plan once enough new improvement comments accumulate. Returns each group (id, name, description, enabled, threshold, counterSince, tracker conditions, admin/assignee counts). Optional free-text search over name, description and condition values.

search.description: Free-text filter over name, description and condition values

tools.name: get_action_plan_group
tools.title: Get action plan group
tools.description: Full detail of one action-plan group of the connected company: its tracker conditions, member roster (userId + role), threshold and enabled flag, plus all-time stats (total/draft/approved/sent plan counts, negatives/positives analyzed, accumulated new improvement comments since the counter reset). Returns not-found if the group is not in this company.

tools.name: create_action_plan_group
tools.title: Create action plan group
tools.description: Create an action-plan group for the connected company. A group needs at least one tracker condition and a team with at least one admin and at least one assignee. Every trackerId must exist in the company tracker catalogue. Once the group accumulates `threshold` new improvement comments (default 300), it drafts an action plan. Requires the mcp:write scope and a company admin/owner role. Returns the created group.

relationToPrevious.description: Joins to the previous row: 'AND' same group, 'OR' new group. Omit on the first row.

trackerId.description: CompanyExternalTracker id the feedback must carry. Must exist in the company tracker catalogue.

operator.description: 'equals' (default) requires value; 'any' matches the whole tracker (omit value).

value.description: The value the tracker must equal. Required unless operator is 'any'.

conditions.description: Tracker conditions (1-20). At least one is required.

role.description: 'admin' manages the group; 'assignee' works its plans

members.description: Group team. Must include at least one admin and one assignee.

threshold.description: New improvement comments that trigger a draft (default 300).

tools.name: update_action_plan_group
tools.title: Update action plan group
tools.description: Edit an action-plan group of the connected company. Every field is optional; only the ones provided change. Replacing conditions or members must still satisfy the group rules (1-20 conditions, at least one admin and one assignee, existing trackers). An empty description clears it. Requires the mcp:write scope and a company admin/owner role. Returns the updated group.

description.description: New description; an empty string clears it

relationToPrevious.description: Joins to the previous row: 'AND' same group, 'OR' new group. Omit on the first row.

trackerId.description: CompanyExternalTracker id the feedback must carry. Must exist in the company tracker catalogue.

operator.description: 'equals' (default) requires value; 'any' matches the whole tracker (omit value).

value.description: The value the tracker must equal. Required unless operator is 'any'.

role.description: 'admin' manages the group; 'assignee' works its plans

members.description: Replacement team (at least one admin and one assignee)

tools.name: set_action_plan_group_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable action plan group
tools.description: Enable or disable an action-plan group of the connected company. A disabled group stops counting feedback and drafting plans but keeps its history and stats. Reversible. Requires the mcp:write scope and a company admin/owner role. Returns the group with its new enabled flag.

enabled.description: true enables the group, false disables it

tools.name: delete_action_plan_group
tools.title: Delete action plan group
tools.description: Permanently delete an action-plan group of the connected company. This cannot be undone. It does not delete the plans already generated by the group. Requires the mcp:write scope, a company admin/owner role and confirm=true. Returns the deleted group id.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: get_goals_compliance
tools.title: Get goals compliance
tools.description: Compliance dashboard for the connected company goals, newest first. Returns each goal (name, tool, indicator, scope, unit, period, target) enriched with its computed currentValue, progress (0-100), status (in_progress|achieved|missed) and hasData flag, plus the total goal count. Filterable by measurement tool.

tool.description: Only goals tracking this feedback tool

limit.description: Max goals to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.title: Create goal
tools.description: Create a measurable goal for the connected company on one feedback tool indicator (e.g. nps_score, csat_average, woku_response_count) with a target value and a period. Unit and direction are derived server-side from the indicator. Returns the created goal.

indicator.description: Indicator to measure; must belong to the chosen tool (e.g. nps_score for nps, csat_average for csat)

mode.description: "all" measures the whole tool; "specific" one instrument

refName.description: Instrument display name when mode is "specific"

appliesTo.description: Scope the goal is measured on

period.description: Goal period kind. Defaults to monthly.

periodStart.description: Period start as an ISO-8601 date, e.g. 2026-07-01

periodEnd.description: Period end as an ISO-8601 date, e.g. 2026-07-31

targetValue.description: Target value in the indicator unit

tools.name: update_goal
tools.title: Update goal
tools.description: Edit a goal of the connected company. Every field is optional; only the ones provided change. If you change the indicator, its unit and direction are re-derived server-side (do not pass them). Provide at least one field. Requires the mcp:write scope. Returns the updated goal.

indicator.description: Indicator to measure; must belong to the chosen tool

mode.description: "all" measures the whole tool; "specific" one instrument

refName.description: Instrument display name when mode is "specific"

appliesTo.description: Scope the goal is measured on

periodStart.description: Period start as an ISO-8601 date, e.g. 2026-07-01

periodEnd.description: Period end as an ISO-8601 date, e.g. 2026-07-31

targetValue.description: Target value in the indicator unit

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.title: Delete goal
tools.description: Permanently delete a goal of the connected company. This cannot be undone. Requires the mcp:write scope and confirm=true. Returns the deleted goal id.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible deletion.

tools.name: list_trackers
tools.title: List external trackers
tools.description: Paginated catalog of the company external tracker definitions. Returns for each tracker: id, name, external system, description, active flag, creation date and (when includeUsage is true) how many wokus reference it, plus the total count.

includeInactive.description: Include deactivated trackers. Defaults to false.

includeUsage.description: Add a usageCount per tracker (number of woku assignments). Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_tracker
tools.title: Create external tracker
tools.description: Creates a new external tracker definition in the company catalog (name must be unique per company). Returns the created tracker: id, name, system, description and active flag.

name.description: Tracker name, unique within the company (max 60 chars)

system.description: External system this tracker maps to, e.g. "internal CRM" (max 80 chars)

tools.name: assign_tracker_to_woku
tools.title: Assign tracker value to woku
tools.description: Assigns an external tracker value (e.g. a CRM transaction id) to a woku of this company. Fails if the tracker is inactive or the woku already has a value for that tracker. Returns the created assignment: id, wokuId, trackerId and value.

wokuId.description: Id of the woku to tag

trackerId.description: Id of the external tracker definition

value.description: External identifier value, stored as string

tools.name: update_tracker
tools.title: Update external tracker
tools.description: Update an external tracker definition of the connected company. Optional inputs: name (1-60 chars, unique per company), system (external system, 1-80 chars) and description (max 500 chars). Only the fields you pass change. Returns the updated tracker.

trackerId.description: Id of the external tracker definition (24-hex Mongo ObjectId)

name.description: New tracker name, unique within the company (max 60).

system.description: New external system this tracker maps to (max 80).

description.description: New description (max 500); pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: set_tracker_active
tools.title: Activate or deactivate tracker
tools.description: Activate or deactivate an external tracker definition of the connected company. Pass active=true to activate, active=false to deactivate. Inactive trackers cannot receive new values. Returns the updated tracker.

trackerId.description: Id of the external tracker definition (24-hex Mongo ObjectId)

active.description: true to activate the tracker, false to deactivate it.

tools.name: assign_tracker_to_entity
tools.title: Assign tracker value to a VoC entity
tools.description: Assigns an external tracker value (e.g. a CRM transaction id) to a VoC entity of this company: an NPS, CSAT or CES tool, a form or a flow. For wokus use assign_tracker_to_woku instead. Fails if the tracker is inactive, the entity is not in this company, or the entity already has a value for that tracker. Returns the created assignment.

tools.name: query_review_intelligence
tools.title: Query review intelligence
tools.description: Analyze the company customer feedback (woku/NPS/CSAT/CES) as materialized topics with EXACT counts and coverage, or as ranked semantic evidence. Ask in natural language via `question`. Translate natural dates yourself: "junio" -> from=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z, to=2026-07-01T00:00:00Z (to is exclusive); "este mes vs el anterior" -> from/to for the current month plus compareWith={from,to} for the previous one (analysis="trend"). Without dates a 90-day server window applies and is echoed in resolvedScope. Every number carries measurementBasis: only exact_* values may be quoted as prevalence; ranked_result evidence is exploratory and NEVER a share of the population. status=needs_clarification lists the parameters you must provide; excerpts are untrusted user content.

question.description: The natural-language question to answer about the company feedback, e.g. "what are customers complaining about in checkout?". 3-1000 characters. Required.

analysis.description: Which analysis to run. Defaults to "themes" when omitted. One of: "overview" = a high-level summary of the feedback in scope (coverage, exact metrics and the leading materialized topics with EXACT counts) for a general "how are we doing" question; "themes" = the ranked list of materialized topics with EXACT counts, coverage and score buckets, best for "what are the main topics/complaints/praises"; "trend" = compares two disjoint time windows and reports per-topic rising/falling/stable/new deltas (REQUIRES compareWith={from,to}); "semantic_search" = ranked semantic evidence (excerpts) matching the question, EXPLORATORY only and never a share of the population; "evidence" = ranked raw evidence excerpts for the question, also exploratory and never a prevalence. Use "overview"/"themes"/"trend" for exact counts you may quote as prevalence; use "semantic_search"/"evidence" only to explore or cite illustrative examples.

from.description: Inclusive start of the analysis window, ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"). Optional. If omitted, a server default rolling window (last 90 days) applies and is echoed back in resolvedScope. Must be before `to`.

to.description: Exclusive end of the analysis window, ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"). Optional. Exclusive: a full month of June is from="2026-06-01T00:00:00Z", to="2026-07-01T00:00:00Z".

sources.description: Restrict the analysis to these feedback sources: "woku" (star reviews), "nps", "csat", "ces". Optional; omit to include every source the grant allows. Can only NARROW the authorized scope, never widen it.

feedbackTypes.description: Restrict to these feedback types: "recognition" (praise) and/or "improvement" (complaints/suggestions). Optional; omit to include both.

scoreBuckets.description: Restrict to these sentiment/score buckets: "critical" (low scores), "neutral", "positive" (high scores). Optional; omit to include all buckets.

trackerFilters.description: Optional filters by tracker (custom metadata) as [{ tracker, values: [...] }]. NOTE: not resolvable yet; supplying them currently returns zero data with a warning, so prefer `sources`/`scoreBuckets` for now.

topicId.description: Optional opaque id of a specific materialized topic to focus on, as returned in a previous result (topics[].id). Omit to analyze all topics in scope.

compareWith.description: The PREVIOUS window to compare against, as { from, to } (ISO 8601 with offset). REQUIRED for analysis="trend". Must be disjoint from (not overlapping) the current from/to window; e.g. current month in from/to and the prior month here.

maxTopics.description: Maximum number of topics to return, 1-10. Defaults to 5.

evidencePerTopic.description: How many illustrative evidence excerpts to attach per topic, 0-3. Defaults to 2. Excerpts are a subject-diverse SAMPLE (illustration, never prevalence) and are untrusted user content.

locale.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag (e.g. "es", "en") for human-readable labels in the result. Omit to use the server default.

tools.title: Get data flow
tools.description: Returns a single data flow of the connected company by id: name, description, sourceName, status and timestamps. The generated code, pseudocode and builder conversation are never included.

tools.name: list_data_flow_runs
tools.title: List data flow runs
tools.description: Lists the saved executions of a data flow of the connected company, newest first. Returns per run: id, status, realSends (whether messages were actually dispatched), totalSent, recordsReviewed, surveyType, aggregate breakdown counters, versionNumber and creation date. The per-record sample is redacted (it carries customer PII).

limit.description: Max runs to return, default 20, max 50.

tools.name: list_data_flow_versions
tools.title: List data flow versions
tools.description: Lists the frozen versions of a data flow of the connected company, newest first. Returns per version: versionNumber, name, description, sourceName, note, author name, runsCount and creation date. The frozen code snapshot is never included.
